capabilities: wrap selected text in align tags for center, right, or justify alignment
add alignment options to the right-click context menu
run alignment commands from the command palette
reset alignment tags to restore plain text
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; manual installation required. README states the code was written with AI assistance (Gemini).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to align text to center, right, or justify within notes.
summary: Text alignment plugin that wraps selected text in align tags to center, right-align, or justify it via context menu or commands.
